description: Polygones d'emprises au sol des bâtiments - Saint-Hyacinthe is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Saint-Hyacinthe. Couche de polygones des emprises au sol des bâtiments du territoire de la ville. Contexte de collecte Processus de collecte basé sur les plans d'implantation ou les certificats de localisation fournis par le service de l'urbanisme,. Collecte secondaire basée sur orthophotographies. Méthode de collecte Intégration à partir de plans ou dessin technique utilisant outils cartographiques. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Saint-Hyacinthe. It offers 2 resource(s) in ESRIREST, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
